title: DIG Step Manifest
description: Manifest for a step plugin. Each step is a folder under backend/steps/<id>/ containing manifest.json plus a Python implementation. The manifest drives plugin registration and UI form generation; param specs are read by the frontend to render parameter editors.

id.description: Stable, unique identifier. snake_case. Used in pipeline node 'step' field.

version.description: Semantic version of this step's behavior. Pipelines pin a stepVersion for reproducibility.

label.description: Human-readable display name shown in the step library and on canvas nodes.

description.description: One-paragraph description. Surfaced as tooltip and step-library detail.

category.description: Coarse grouping for the step library. Known values: ingest, shape, clean, derive, combine, aggregate, analyze, model, validate, visualize, output, custom. Free-form string so vendors / packs can add new categories (e.g. 'observability', 'cost_optimization') without a schemaVersion bump; the frontend renders unknown categories under a generic group.

primary.description: Backend execution mode. Known values: 'sql' (compiles to a DuckDB SQL fragment), 'polars' (calls a Polars Python implementation), 'python' (generic Python implementation). Free-form string so enterprise builds can add backends (spark, dask, snowflake_pushdown, bigquery_pushdown, etc.) without a schemaVersion bump; unknown engines are unrunnable in OSS and surface as a clear error.

browser.description: Browser execution mode. 'sql' runs the same SQL fragment under DuckDB-WASM; 'js' runs a JavaScript mirror implementation; 'none' forces backend execution. See docs/PIPELINE_FORMAT.md for the parity contract.

deterministic.description: True if the step always produces the same output for the same input + params. False steps cannot be browser-runnable.

ports.description: Named input ports (e.g. ['left','right'] for a join). Optional; defaults to ['in'] for single-input steps.
Named output ports. Defaults to ['out'] for single-output steps.

params.description: Parameter spec map. Keys are param names; values are paramSpec entries that drive UI form generation.

preview.description: Hints used by the UI to render row/schema-impact badges before execution.

metadata.description: Free-form pack/author metadata not interpreted by DIG core.

extensions.description: Namespaced extension fields. Vendors / enterprise / forks attach their own data under a top-level namespace key (e.g. extensions.acme.benchmarkId) so future first-party fields never collide.

aliases.description: Search synonyms surfaced only by the picker's intent-ranked search (not displayed). Add the words a user might type instead of the step's label — e.g. 'where', 'predicate' for filter_rows; 'merge', 'lookup' for join.

requires.description: Upstream-schema preconditions used by the picker to grey out steps that can't run against the current upstream node. Each clause is AND-combined; a clause is satisfied when at least `min` upstream columns match any of the listed type buckets. UX hint only — backend execution is unaffected.

recommendedMaxRows.description: Soft upper bound on input rows for a usable visualization. The frontend renders a 'data is dense — consider aggregating first' banner above the live chart preview when the upstream node's row count exceeds this value. UX hint only — does NOT change rendering behaviour. For chart steps with multiple kinds (e.g. export_to_image) supply a per-kind map keyed by the `kind` param value, with an optional `_default` for kinds that don't have an explicit entry.

oneOf.description: Single threshold for chart steps that always render the same kind (funnel / pareto / waterfall).
Per-kind threshold map. Frontend looks up `params.kind`; falls back to `_default` if the kind isn't keyed.
Any-of: a column matches the clause if its type is in any listed bucket.

kind.description: Type bucket or list of buckets that satisfies this clause.

min.description: Minimum number of upstream columns matching the bucket(s) (default 1).

requirementBucket.description: Coarse type bucket. See frontend/lib/step-requirements.ts for the physical/meta-type membership map.

type.description: Logical parameter type. column_ref/column_refs are first-class — the UI populates a picker from the upstream node's inferred output schema.

enumLabels.description: For type=='enum': parallel array of human-readable hints (one per enum value). Rendered as 'value — label' in the picker so option semantics surface BEFORE the user selects.

columnFrom.description: For column_ref/column_refs: input port id whose schema feeds this picker. Defaults to 'in'.

columnTypes.description: For column_ref/column_refs: filter the picker to columns of these logical types (e.g. ['integer','double']).

visibleWhen.description: Show this param only when sibling params equal the given values. Equality only — no expressions. A param key may also map to an array of allowed values (the param shows for any match).

widget.description: Optional UI hint requesting a richer editor than the default for this paramSpec.type. Frontend may ignore unknown values. Examples: 'filter_builder', 'expression_builder', 'list_input'.
